newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS--Comcast, TCI debt higher.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS--Comcast, TCI debt higher.

text.p: An upgrade in Comcast Corp's debt rating and a new venture involving TCI Communications Inc pushed the bonds of those cable companies higher, while overall U.S. corporate bond prices benefitted from strength in Treasuries and stocks on Tuesday, market players said.

Moody's Investors Service raised its rating of Comcast Cable Communications debt to investment-grade (Baa3) from junk bond status (Ba1) on Tuesday. The move made Comcast Cable, the holding company for all Comcast Corp's cable operations, a fully high-grade company. S&P already rated it BBB-minus.
